text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye~! Take care, Grandma~! 
Phew, glad that's taken care of. Now, back 
to everyone—huh?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...My pocket feels kind of light? 
Wait, was it this pocket? Hmmm...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh... Where did I put 
that stick I found at the observation 
deck!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I can't find it. 
I'm pretty sure we have the right room, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The room where all numbers gather; look 
to the skies, and the treasure lies." 
I thought I checked all the higher spots, 
but did I overlook something?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We have limited time, so perhaps we should 
double-check our interpretation of the 
riddle.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Then is it okay if Rice goes to get 
Urara-chan 
in the meantime? She's taking a while, so 
I'm worried...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I shall accompany you, then. 
Moving around might help spark a new idea.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's not here either...! 
Where could I have dropped it? I have to 
find it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Thank goodness, here you are. 
Urara-chan, what are you doing out here?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Rice-chan! You see, on my way back from 
the bathroom, 
there was a lost grandma, so I walked her 
to her room.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then I realized I dropped the stick I 
found at the observation deck, so I've 
been looking for it! 
I'm sorry, I'll find it right away!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Without that stick, I won't be able to run 
with everyone. 
And I really, really don't want that!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, I enrolled in Tracen Academy 
because I wanted to run so much. 
I wanted to enter all kinds of races and 
feel so much excitement!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The thrill of a race changes depending on 
who you're running with, right? 
That's why I definitely want to run in the 
Beauty Dream Cup, too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Running with you and everyone else would 
be a whole new kind of excitement. 
And if I could win first place in a race 
like that, I know I'd be so happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna find that stick right away! 
It's gotta be somewhere along the path I 
walked!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-Then Rice will help you look for it...! 
Rice wants to run together with you, too, 
Urara-chan...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The reason Rice wants to become a Muse is 
to make everyone smile... 
So I want to run with you with a smile on 
our faces, too...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to help as well. No matter how 
precious the item is, 
it would defeat the purpose entirely if 
you were to rush and injure yourself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As Umamusume who compete in races, it is 
vital that we 
always maintain peak condition to prevent 
such misfortunes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... there is no need to hesitate, 
Urara-san. 
First, could you tell me the route you 
took to escort the lady?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So, the hotel staff told us the annex was 
connected by a hallway, 
so I went down to the first floor with the 
grandma, and—ah!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Grandma got tired 
along the way, 
so we took a b-r-e-a-k in the garden!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Have you not searched there yet? 
If so, then perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Let's go check, Urara-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Curren-san? Pardon me, we ran into a bit 
of a problem. 
The two of them are currently heading to 
the hotel courtyard to search for 
something.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"You might be able to see it from there as 
well.\nThe window should be facing the 
courtyard... so—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Um, Curren-san. An idea just crossed my 
mind.\nCould you open the curtains and 
stand by the window?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"'In the room where all numbers gather, 
look up to find the treasure. 
The beginning of a legend: on your mark.'"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"The riddle said 'The room, a place to 
gaze up at', right?\nHowever, rather than 
gazing up at something from inside the 
room—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Could it mean that the treasure is in a 
place\nwhere you can gaze up at the room?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "Found it! Urara-chan, I found it!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Huh, why?! There's one over here too?!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, it turned out the riddle meant 
the treasure was in 'a place to gaze up at 
the room', not 'a place to gaze up from 
the room.'"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"That was fine play, Ikuno-san♪\nAlso, we 
found out why Urara-san couldn't come back 
earlier."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"She dropped her stick and was looking for 
it all by herself.\nAnd what do you think 
Rice-san and the others said to her?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The reason Rice wants to become a Muse is 
to make everyone smile... 
So I want to run with you with a smile on 
our faces, too...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to help as well. No matter how 
precious the item is, 
it would defeat the purpose entirely if 
you were to rush and injure yourself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As Umamusume who compete in races, it is 
vital that we 
always maintain peak condition to prevent 
such misfortunes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I see... That's what the two of them 
cherish, isn't it?\nThe smiles of those 
close to them, and managing themselves to 
keep running in top condition."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"And Urara-chan's strong desire to cherish 
every single race\nand run aiming for 
first place..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"(Everyone has their own 'ideal' self they 
aspire to be.\nHow does that connect to 
pursuing Beauty-san's Racewear?)"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"(I don't know... but,\nI feel like I'm so 
close to the answer...!)"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Now, let's get going soon, 
Fine-san.\nLet's solve the 'Final Riddle' 
in a totally 'cute' way, okay!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, absolutely.\nLet's take on the 
challenge proudly, true to who we are!"

text_block_list.name: Hotel Concierge
text_block_list.text:
"You must be the challengers for the 
'Final Riddle.'\nI have received 
instructions from Lady Beauty."

text_block_list.name: Hotel Concierge
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, first... please step inside 
here.\n—Right this way."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"『—Bonjour, it's Beauty Anshinzawa! 
You've done well\nto make it this far, my 
brilliant rough diamonds♪』"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: This voice... is it a broadcast?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"『You have a mere 10 minutes for the 
'Final Riddle.'\nNow, show me your 
ultimate beauty!』"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"『At the right time, in the right 
place.\nUse the photograph as your hint to 
obtain the [Church Key]!』"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time to take on the last 
riddle challenge!
